info.title: apkg
info.description: A CLI client tool for the Apkg package server.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a new Apkg package manifest in the current directory.

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the new package.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory where the package manifest will be created. [default: .]

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Pack a package from a source directory into an .apkg file.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path to the package source directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory for the packed .apkg file. [default: .]
